items.title: 66960_Gil Evans oral history interview
items.q: Henderson is the one who made Benny Goodman popular. He died a pauper.

ctx.x: Oh, (Glen Gray Graves?). Yes, yes, yes.

Before anybody knew Glen Gray they called it the Casa Loma Orchestra at the time. (?). Later they decided that they needed a name even though they were a co-operative for a long time. It was a very good band. Fletcher Henderson.....
I was just telling my students....
